replies.body:
After a conclusion of the name being fine we'd like you to notice these 2 points explaining why it isn't offensive.


1. The name has little to no connection regarding jews except the legitimate word in it, meaning this is not offensive nor punishable.

2. Junr himself is completely fine with Cole having his name like that.

We appreciate the fact that your mode time to create this report and feel free to rbing up any more rule breakers you see! For now, this report is denied.

Cheers, Josh!
